description: A shell script for testing Git add -e functionality with some embedded text processing and patch generation.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the Git timestamp for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with specific commands.

methods.name: test_set_editor
methods.description: Sets a custom shell script as the editor for Git commands.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files for equality, used for validating test outputs.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that a command is expected to fail.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks that a command exits with a specific code.
